messages:
Alex: Quick sync — where do we stand on the console observability roadmap for the next sprint? I care about: dashboards (final widgets), tracing hooks (all services), error-analysis views, and retention milestones. Can owners + blockers call out status?
Maria: Dashboards: most widgets done, PRs #3421 and #3430 in review. Need final approval from UX for the widget layout (cc @Alex). I can merge Wed if no major comments. :thumbsup:
Sachin: Tracing hooks: instrumentation PR 987 is merged for frontend and api-gateway, still working on model-serve service. There's a failing test in model-serve around async span flush, failing locally: `SpanFlushError: timeout` — digging. ETA Friday.
Jen: Retention milestone: proposal uploaded to the doc (see link) — recommending 90d for traces, 365d for error indexes. Need storage estimate to confirm cost impact.
Luke: Blocking dependency: eng-infra needs to enable the new ingestion topic in staging. I pinged infra ticket INF-1290 yesterday, waiting on region quota confirmation. Without that we can't run full end-to-end.
Maria: Error-analysis views: I sketched the initial dashboards but need someone from data to validate the aggregation queries. Who owns the grouping logic? @Sachin?
Sachin: I can take a pass on the aggregation logic, but I want to align on grouping keys. Proposed keys: service, endpoint, top_exception, user_tier. Will open a short PR with SQL snippets by EOD.
Jen: Storage estimate quick calc (rough): traces/day ~ 40M spans -> after sampling ~ 4M kept -> avg 1.5KB/span => ~6GB/day -> 90d ~540GB. Errors + indexes add another ~200GB. So 90d traces + 365d errors ~= ~2.4TB. Back-of-envelope, need infra to price S3 + query costs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: New canary for `console-obsv` deployed to staging at 2026-03-01T14:05:03Z. Canary ID: cb-553.
Alex: Good call on owners. Action items: Maria merges dashboard PRs (target Wed), Sachin finishes model-serve hook + open aggregation PR (target Fri), Luke to chase INF-1290 and confirm ingestion topic (target Thu), Jen to finalize retention doc with the updated estimate and flag cost delta, eng-infra to provide S3 pricing delta. If anyone can't hit ETA, post a short update here.
Maria: Will post merge checklist once UX approves.
Sachin: I'll post the failing test log here and a temporary workaround for the span flush.
Luke: I'll escalate INF-1290 to infra oncall if no reply by EOD.
Jen: I'll add a small sensitivity table to the doc (90/180/365) so we can see tradeoffs.
Alex: Thanks — let's do a mid-week quick check-in on Thurs morning if anything slips. :calendar:
